children: Collector Crypt lets eligible Trust Wallet users buy collectible packs with crypto and open them in the wallet. The packs contain graded collectibles from Pokémon, basketball and watch collections. Users can keep the items they pull from the packs or resell them.
The integration gives Collector Crypt a new way to reach buyers through Trust Wallet. The benefit for Trust Wallet's own token is indirect.
Pulling cards just landed on Trust Wallet 🔥
Rip Pokémon and collectible packs onchain, right from your wallet.

title: Collector Crypt: Collectible packs go live in Trust Wallet - 25 Nov 2026
